# Boblo

> Boblo is a modern, full-stack social media platform built for real-time microblogging, post sharing, user interactions, and profile customisation.

## Routes & Resources

- [Home Feed](https://www.boblo.ir/): Main timeline displaying community posts and user activity.
- [Authentication](https://www.boblo.ir/auth): Sign in or create a new user account.
- [User Profile Management](https://www.boblo.ir/profile): View user profiles and posted content.
- [Sitemap](https://www.boblo.ir/sitemap.xml): Full XML index of public profiles and posts.

## Features

- **Public Timeline**: Read community posts, likes, retweets, and interactions in real time.
- **User Profiles**: Custom user handles, avatars, cover images, and bio details.
- **Post Sharing**: Create, edit, and reply to posts.
- **Authentication**: Secure account management and session control.

## Optional

- [Robots Directive](https://www.boblo.ir/robots.txt): Crawler rules and sitemap indexing directives.
